% Appendix B -- Complete result tables (auto-generated from results/)

\chapter{Complete Result Tables}

\label{AppendixB}

This appendix presents the mitigation results from Chapters~\ref{chap5:results} and~\ref{chap6:realistic}.
The \texttt{results/} directory holds the circuit-grouped kernel comparisons.
The main, sweep and follow-up files use the \texttt{paired\_kernel} prefix.
The realistic and robustness comparisons use the \texttt{paired\_realistic}
and \texttt{robust\_pairs} prefixes, respectively. The robustness files name
the reference in each row. The circuit--shot replication reports cell scores
and paired intervals in the \texttt{folding\_seed} result files.
